title: Structured-Noise Masked Modeling for Video, Audio and Beyond
abstract: arXiv:2503.16311v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Masked modeling has emerged as a robust self-supervised learning framework. However, most methods rely on random masking, which disregards the structural properties of different data modalities. To align with the spatiotemporal and spectral characteristics of video and audio data, we introduce a structured noise-based masking approach. By filtering white noise into different color noise distributions, we generate structured masks that capture modality-specific patterns without requiring handcrafted heuristics or access to the data. Our approach enhances masked video and audio modeling frameworks without any additional computational cost. Experiments show that structured noise masking consistently outperforms random masking, underscoring the value of modality-aware masking strategies for representation learning.

translated_title: 面向视频、音频及更多模态的结构化噪声掩码建模
translated_abstract: 掩码建模已成为一种强大的自监督学习框架。然而，大多数方法依赖于随机掩码，这忽略了不同数据模态的结构特性。为了契合视频和音频数据的时空特性与频谱特性，我们提出了一种基于结构化噪声的掩码方法。通过将白噪声过滤为不同颜色的噪声分布，我们生成了能够捕捉模态特定模式的结构化掩码，且无需手工设计的启发式规则或访问数据本身。我们的方法在不增加任何额外计算成本的情况下增强了掩码视频和音频建模框架。实验表明，结构化噪声掩码始终优于随机掩码，凸显了模态感知掩码策略在表示学习中的价值。
tldr: 该论文提出一种通过将白噪声过滤为不同颜色噪声分布来生成结构化掩码的方法，无需手工启发式规则或访问数据即可捕捉视频、音频等模态的结构特性，在零额外计算成本下使掩码建模性能持续优于随机掩码。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes generating structured masks by filtering white noise into different color noise distributions, which captures modality-specific patterns for video and audio without handcrafted heuristics or data access, consistently outperforming random masking with no additional computational cost.
